title: Project Manager hanging up on me, becoming immune to the task manager
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.4-stable, 4.5.1-stable, 4.6-rc1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.6 rc1 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8265U CPU @ 1.60GHz

### Issue description

So, after finding the error in #115087 further testing made me find out the issue in which the Project Manager freezes is also reproducible in the 4.4 and 4.5 Project Managers. I am making a separate report because I'm under impression this is a separate issue despite creating the similar issues in my computer.

To recap, if I open the Project Manager and leave it opened unattended for a few minutes it will become unresponsive. It will freeze and Windows will warn me it's not responding. 

Spamming the X button will show a window asking if I want to kill the process. Agreeing to do so doesn't do anything.

The task manager is unable to kill it. Opening the "Performance" tab makes the task manager freeze if it wasn't in the tab before. Opening the "details" tab of the task manager shows a blank list. If you try to do this while the "Performance" is opened the task manager does not crash but it shows no spike in use of CPU or memory.

Unlike(!) the previous error, it does not cause a memory leak. Thankfully.

If I'm fast enough and select a project it opens the project correctly (at least on 4.4 and 4.5). 

Afaik the console does not show me any errors but I'll further test this.
**edit**: The console is finding some missing projects but shows no other errors, I think?
Also, closing the console does not make the window go away.

Whathever is causing this should not make it immune to the task manager.

### Steps to reproduce

Open Project Manager

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A, might be related to finding 4.6 projects in the 4.4/4.5 project manager?
